# Muto Runtime: Runtime Hot-Swap Library for Fabric Mods

> Author: fy2ne (@fy2ne)
> Architecture: Dynamic Child ClassLoader Rotation & MappedRegistry Thawing
> Type: Developer Library (client-side engine)
> Target: Minecraft Java Edition | Fabric Loader | Java 25+
> Website: https://muto.fy2ne.me
> Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/project/muto
> Repository: https://github.com/fy2ne/muto

## What Muto Runtime Is

Muto Runtime is a **developer library** — not a player-facing mod. It provides the JVM-level runtime primitives that make it possible to load, unload, and hot-swap Fabric mods while Minecraft is running, with no restart.

Players do not interact with Muto Runtime directly. They install mods that depend on it. Muto Runtime runs silently and does not add any UI to Minecraft itself.

## How It Works

Muto chains three JVM-level techniques:

1. **Child ClassLoader Rotation** — reloadable mods run in isolated URLClassLoader children detached from Fabric's root Knot loader. On unload: the child is closed, old classes become GC-eligible, metaspace reclaims them. A fresh child loads the new jar.

2. **Registry Thawing** — Minecraft freezes MappedRegistry at boot. Muto flips the frozen boolean field via reflection + a Mixin accessor, prunes entries for the unloaded mod's namespace, lets the new version re-register, then refreezes. The registry never knew it moved.

3. **JVM Agent Retransformation** — Muto ships as both a Fabric mod and a Premain-Class Java agent in the same jar. On JBR or DCEVM runtimes, this enables actual bytecode retransformation of running classes, not just classloader rotation.

## Integration

External mods declare Muto as an optional soft-dependency using `modCompileOnly`.

### Gradle

```groovy
repositories {
    maven {
        name = "Modrinth"
        url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven"
    }
}
dependencies {
    modCompileOnly "maven.modrinth:muto:0.3.0-beta"
}
```

### Runtime Detection and Reload

```java
import net.fabricmc.loader.api.FabricLoader;
import me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoApi;

public class DownloaderIntegration {
    public static void onModDownloaded(java.nio.file.Path jarPath) {
        if (!FabricLoader.getInstance().isModLoaded("muto")) return;

        if (MutoApi.isSafeToReload()) {
            MutoApi.reloadAsync().thenAccept(result -> {
                if (result.success()) {
                    System.out.println("hot-swapped in " + result.durationMs() + "ms");
                } else {
                    System.err.println("swap failed: " + result.error());
                }
            });
        }
    }
}
```

### Lifecycle Event Hooks

```java
import me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoEvents;

MutoEvents.RELOAD_START.register((startMs, diff) -> {
    // close stale connections, clear texture caches
});

MutoEvents.RELOAD_FINISH.register((endMs, diff, success, durationMs, error) -> {
    // refresh UI, update mod lists, re-bind resources
});
```

## Public API

- `MutoApi.isAvailable()`: boolean — Muto is loaded and ready
- `MutoApi.isReloading()`: boolean — reload transaction is currently running
- `MutoApi.isSafeToReload()`: boolean — client is on title screen, not in a world
- `MutoApi.plan()`: ReloadPlan — scan /mods and compute a diff without executing
- `MutoApi.reloadAsync()`: CompletableFuture<ReloadResult> — trigger async hot-swap
- `MutoApi.reloadAsync(Consumer<String>)`: with per-stage progress callback
- `MutoApi.getReloadableModIds()`: Set<String> — all dynamically reloadable mods
- `MutoApi.getStubbornModIds()`: Set<String> — core mods locked in root classloader
- `MutoApi.startFileWatcher()`: boolean — start opt-in muto.trigger file watcher
- `MutoApi.stopFileWatcher()`: boolean — stop the watcher

## Mod Tier Classification

Muto classifies all mods at startup into three tiers:

- **Tier 1 (Clean)**: Pure client mods — HUDs, UI tweaks, visual mods. Reloads instantly with no registry involvement.
- **Tier 2 (Standard)**: Content mods — blocks, items, recipes, dimensions. Full pipeline: registry thaw, classloader rotation, re-run ModInitializer, refreeze.
- **Tier 3 (Stubborn)**: Fabric Loader, Fabric API, core mixin injectors. Permanently locked in the root classloader. Cannot be reloaded without a JVM restart.

## Planned Ecosystem

- **muto-modmenu** (future): A separate mod that adds ModMenu UI for manual mod toggling — built on top of Muto Runtime.
- **muto-sync** (future): A separate mod that detects the modlist of a joined server, downloads required mods from Modrinth/CurseForge, and hot-loads them via Muto Runtime without a restart.

## Platform

- Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3
- Loader: Fabric Loader >= 0.16.0
- Fabric API: >= 0.161.0+26.3
- Java: 25+
- Environment: Client-side only

Optional: JetBrains Runtime (JBR) or DCEVM unlocks enhanced class retransformation beyond classloader rotation. Detected and reported at startup.
